title: The Bogoliubov momentum law for the dilute hard-sphere ground state
exact_target: For fixed hard-sphere radius $a>0$, do all pure or mixed bosonic ground states in periodic cubes have a common dilute-limit nonzero-momentum occupation law: after the thermodynamic limit at fixed rho and then rho $a^3\to 0$, the measure (N sqrt(rho $a^3))^{-1}sum_{k\neq 0}n_\Gamma (k)\delta _(k/\operatorname{sqrt}(8\pi $ rho a)) converges against every bounded continuous real test to the source Bogoliubov measure? Require uniformity over the whole ground-state space.
